   184→    block_root: Hash256,

   187→}

   189→impl<T: BeaconChainTypes, O: ObservationStrategy> Clone for GossipVerifiedDataColumn<T, O> {
   190→    fn clone(&self) -> Self {

   223→        chain: &BeaconChain<T>,

   236→            .is_data_column_cached(&column_sidecar.block_root(), &column_sidecar)

   241→            }

   243→        }

   247→            data_column: KzgVerifiedDataColumn::from_execution_verified(column_sidecar),
   248→            _phantom: Default::default(),
